summary: Re-tested both regression fixes plus full flows. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed (registrations with notification_sent/notification_error transparency + MongoDB persistence, contacts persistence, validation 422s, 4 PDF downloads with %PDF- signature, 404 for unknown material). Resend email actually delivered (notification_sent=true, notification_error=null persisted in DB, no errors in backend logs). Frontend: share button with navigator.share removed + clipboard.writeText rejecting NotAllowedError + execCommand disabled produced NO webpack overlay, showed fallback toast 'Salin tautan manual: <url>', and close-content-detail still closed the modal. Registration modal flow (POST 200, confetti, success toast, modal closes), contact form (POST 200, toast, fields reset), PDF download from UI, tutorial/article hash-shareable detail URLs, mobile 390x844 nav menu with no horizontal scroll (scrollWidth==clientWidth on home & kursus), WhatsApp float -> wa.me/6287741844019. All copy in Bahasa Indonesia.

minor.issue: Email is sent synchronously inside the request (blocking Resend call adds latency, ~0.5-1s). Consider BackgroundTasks.
No GET/list endpoint exists, so persistence can only be verified directly against MongoDB; also no rate limiting on public write endpoints (spam risk).

issues: Floating WhatsApp button overlaps card content/right edge of text at small widths; consider bottom offset or smaller size

action_items: Optional: align data-testid names with docs (request mentioned register-name-input / register-course-select / whatsapp-float; actual are register-modal-name / register-modal-course / floating-whatsapp-btn)
Optional: move Resend send to FastAPI BackgroundTasks to avoid blocking the registration response
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/App.js is 1625 lines - split into components (Navbar, Hero, Courses, Articles, Modals) for maintainability
NOTIFY_RECIPIENT has a hardcoded default fallback in server.py; prefer failing fast or leaving unset
Registration/contact writes are unauthenticated and unthrottled; add basic anti-abuse (rate limit / honeypot)

Fix #2: NOTIFY_RECIPIENT changed to the Resend account owner address, satisfying Resend testing-mode restriction; notify_registration returns (sent, error) which is stored and echoed in the API response.
